reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I travel twice a month and a daily sachet in my bag beats a bottle in my suitcase. Bisglycinate is the one I keep hearing about for sleep, and $29.99 with free shipping is an easy cart tap if the creator's video hit my problem.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps, or is this just a nice box with a QR code on it?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real people in creator videos say they slept better or had fewer cramps after a couple of weeks would make me buy a second box; a bad batch report or a weak review would flip me to no.
